sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def get_sigs(fr):
    lines = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    nodes = fr.segmentation['nodes']
    def sig(node):
        pts=node['boundary']
        r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
        c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
        return tuple(''.join('1' if lines[r][c]=='B' else '0' for c in range(c0,c1+1)) for r in range(r0,r1+1))
    # find strip glyph nodes: B nodes inside the pink strip (rows 51-57) and blue strip (40-46)
    def strip_sigs(rmin,rmax):
        out=[]
        for n in nodes:
            if n['color']=='B':
                pts=n['boundary']
                r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
                if rmin<=r0 and r1<=rmax:
                    out.append((min(p[1] for p in pts), sig(n)))
        out.sort()
        return [s for _,s in out]
    return strip_sigs(40,46), strip_sigs(51,57)
bB,bP = get_sigs(previous_frame)
aB,aP = get_sigs(current_frame)
print("pink strip before:", [''.join(s) for s in bP])
print("pink strip after: ", [''.join(s) for s in aP])
print("blue strip same:", bB==aB)
r = action(['UP'])
cB,cP = get_sigs(current_frame)
print("pink strip after 2nd UP:", [''.join(s) for s in cP])
print("blue strip same:", bB==cB)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
